# Loops with a Goal {#sec-loops-with-a-goal}

::: {.callout-note}
## Skeleton

Kills: "more steps means better" — repetition needs a stopping
condition, and progress needs a memory of the best so far.

Installs: `run_loop` with a goal, `judged()` thresholds, the ratchet
that keeps only wins. Working build: a paragraph improved until a
stated goal is met, with the iteration count visible.
:::
